title: Rainbow Turán numbers for paths of length four
summary: Given a set $V$ of $n$ vertices and an integer $k\ge1$, our goal is to maximize the number of edges in graphs $G_1, G_2, \ldots, G_k$, defined on $V$, under the constraint that the union of all graphs, thought of as a multi-graph, does not contain a rainbow copy of the path $P_5$ on $5$ vertices, that is, a copy of $P_5$ with each of its four edges belonging to a different $G_i$. We consider two versions of the problem, in which, respectively, $\sum_i e(G_i)$ and $\min_i e(G_i)$ is maximized.
